I do not recommend revenge of any kind. It is never a good idea to seek revenge, as it can lead to more problems and hurt all involved in the long run.
BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How long should I be able to hold my breath? ASSISTANT:
Under normal conditions, a person can hold their breath for up to 30 to 35 seconds.

Seduce him with your eyes, touch, and whisper. Show him you are interested, and be playful and romantic. Build a connection with your touch, and use your body language to flirt. Be feminine, confident, and mysterious.
